$comment: BLOCKED ON ACCOUNT TYPE — do not apply while FloorLamp/allos is user-owned. GitHub offers merge queue only on ORGANIZATION-owned repos (public in any org; private needs Enterprise Cloud), so the apply call 422s with Invalid rule 'merge_queue' here (measured 2026-08-13); no JSON shape fixes that. This file is the transfer-ready artifact: if the repo moves to an org, apply with gh api repos/<org>/allos/rulesets --method POST --input .github/merge-queue-ruleset.json (or Settings -> Rules -> Rulesets, mirroring these values). The required checks are the three cheap tiers + gitleaks, matching what ci.yml runs on merge_group; requiring a check that never reports on merge_group stalls the queue forever. bypass_actors keeps repository admins able to push to main directly (the owner does, mid-session) — those pushes stay covered by ci-main.yml. See docs/orchestration.md, 'The merge queue'.
name: main merge queue
